title: 第9章 找到你了第10章 魔高一丈
slug: 梦中强吻女帝被找上门了怎么办
content_zh:
在林水仙的哭喊求饶声中，江晨掰着她的手指，一根一根撅断。
都说十指连心，林水仙所感受到的痛苦，非言语能够形容。只从她那惨烈的叫声中，就能听出一二。
途中好几次，林水仙都痛得晕厥过去，又一次次痛醒过来，这种死去活来的滋味，让她恨不得立即去死。
“啊啊啊……你杀了我吧！”
等十根手指头都掰完之后，林水仙的嗓子已经喊哑了。
江晨这才松开双手，满意地点点头：“现在，你再回答我，以后还敢吗？”
林水仙痛得涕泪横流，连站都站不稳，一屁股摔在地上，半天起不得。
她用恐惧又怨恨的目光看着江晨，却又不敢不回答，用嘶哑的嗓音说道：“不敢了，真的不敢了。”
“嗯，这回我相信你了。”江晨看着她已经变形的手掌，点了点头。
作为一个盗贼，赖以吃饭的手指伤到了这种程度，就算能治好，灵活程度也肯定大不如前了。
林水仙就算不想改行，也必须改行了。
“凭你的姿色，从事酒托、仙人跳这样有前途的职业不好吗？非要当什么盗贼！下次再见到你，希望你别再偷东西了！”
丢下一句劝告，江晨转身离去。
“是是是，多谢公子的指点……”林水仙嘴里忙不迭地附和，低头一看，只见自己的双手十指以不正常的角度翻了过来，几乎贴到了手背上。
“啊啊啊啊……”林水仙痛哭出声，既是因为疼痛难忍，也是因为前所未有的委屈。
她堂堂「飘香大盗」，貌美如花，西辽城的黑白两道谁不给几分面子，什么时候受过这种委屈？
那么娇嫩的纤纤玉指，别人含在嘴里疼还来不及，何时被这样粗暴地对待过？
好半晌，林水仙才从地上爬起来，擦了一把额头的冷汗，望着江晨离去的背影，心头涌起满腔怨恨，决定马上就回去找「弄月公子」哭诉告状。
江晨正要走出大门，却忽然停下脚步。
并非因为林水仙的哭声，而是去路被人堵住了。

不知何时，门外多出了一个俏生生的翠衣少女，静静地站在那里，不知道站了多久。
对上江晨的视线，翠衣少女微微一笑：“我听见有人在喊抓淫贼，就过来瞧瞧。怎么样，淫贼抓住了吗？”
江晨眼皮一跳，浑身寒毛直竖。
是她！
昨晚的那位“万妖宫主”！
她难道一直跟在我身后？
少女的笑容甜美醉人，但江晨现在只觉得无比虚假，如同鬼怪故事里的画皮一般，多瞧几眼之后，甚至有些毛骨悚然。
这位“万妖宫主”给他带来极度危险的感觉，身体的本能在告诉他——快逃！
江晨眼睛一瞬不瞬地盯着她，浑身肌肉绷紧，沉声道：“这里没有淫贼。”
“你不就是淫贼吗？”翠衣少女视线越过江晨，落在后方的林水仙脸上，“若不然，这位姐姐为什么哭得梨花带雨，如此凄惨？”
林水仙擦了擦眼睛，看清这翠衣少女的模样，也对她的出现十分意外。
刚才在广场上，林水仙看见这少女对江晨笑了一下，还以为这少女是江晨的朋友。现在看来，两人并不认识？
这翠衣小姑娘一脸天真无邪的样子，说不定是个初出茅庐的江湖女侠，或许可以利用她，报复江晨……
content_en:
As Lin Shuixian cried and begged for mercy, Jiang Chen picked off her fingers and broke them off one by one.
It is said that ten fingers are connected to the heart, and the pain Lin Shuixian felt cannot be described in words. Just from her miserable scream, you can tell something.
Several times during the journey, Lin Shuixian fainted from the pain and woke up again and again. This feeling of life and death made her want to die immediately.
"Ahhh...you kill me!"
After all ten fingers were broken, Lin Shuixian's voice was hoarse.
Jiang Chen then let go of his hands and nodded with satisfaction: "Now, if you answer me again, will you still dare to answer me in the future?"
Lin Shuixian was so painful that she burst into tears. She couldn't even stand firmly. She fell to the ground and couldn't get up for a long time.
She looked at Jiang Chen with fear and resentment, but she didn't dare not answer. She said in a hoarse voice: "I don't dare anymore, I really don't dare anymore."
"Well, I believe you this time." Jiang Chen looked at her deformed palm and nodded.
As a thief, if the finger he relies on for food is injured to this extent, even if it can be cured, the flexibility will definitely not be as good as before.
Even if Lin Shuixian doesn't want to change her career, she must change her career.
"With your beauty, wouldn't it be good to pursue a promising career like a bartender or a fairy dancer? You have to be a thief! Next time I see you, I hope you won't steal anything again!"
Without a word of advice, Jiang Chen turned around and left.
"Yes, yes, thank you for your advice..." Lin Shuixian hurriedly agreed. When he looked down, he saw that the fingers of his hands were turned over at abnormal angles, almost touching the back of his hands.
"Ahhhhh..." Lin Shuixian cried out in pain, not only because of the unbearable pain, but also because of the unprecedented grievance.
She is a majestic "fragrant thief" and as beautiful as a flower. Who among the black and white people in Xiliao City wouldn't give her some face? When have they ever suffered such injustice?
Such delicate and slender jade fingers can be held in someone's mouth before it hurts. When has it ever been treated so roughly?
After a long while, Lin Shuixian got up from the ground, wiped the cold sweat from his forehead, looked at Jiang Chen's leaving back, filled with resentment in his heart, and decided to go back to "Mr. Nong Yue" immediately to complain.
Jiang Chen was about to walk out of the door, but suddenly stopped.
It wasn't because of Lin Shuixian's cry, but because the way was blocked.
At some point, a pretty girl in green clothes appeared outside the door, standing there quietly for who knows how long.
Meeting Jiang Chen's gaze, the girl in green clothes smiled slightly: "I heard someone shouting to catch the thief, so I came over to take a look. How is it, has the thief been caught?"
Jiang Chen's eyelids twitched, and the hair on his body stood up.
It's her!
The "Master of the Palace of Ten Thousand Demons" last night!
Has she been following me?
The girl's smile was sweet and intoxicating, but Jiang Chen now felt that it was extremely fake, like the painted skin in a ghost story. After looking at it a few more times, it even became a little creepy.
This "Master of the Palace of Ten Thousand Demons" gave him a feeling of extreme danger, and his body's instinct was telling him - run away!
Jiang Chen's eyes stared at her for a moment, his muscles tensed up, and he said in a deep voice: "There are no lechers here."
"Aren't you just a thief?" The girl in green clothes looked past Jiang Chen and landed on the face of Lin Shuixian behind her. "If not, why is this sister crying so miserably?"
Lin Shuixian wiped her eyes and saw clearly the appearance of the girl in green clothes, and was very surprised by her appearance.
In the square just now, Lin Shuixian saw the girl smiling at Jiang Chen and thought that the girl was Jiang Chen's friend. Now it seems that the two of them don’t know each other?
This little girl in green clothes has an innocent look on her face. She might be a fledgling heroine. Maybe she can be used to take revenge on Jiang Chen...
